Leah Morgan: Quick sync 1: Launch social for 'Serving Patterns' webinar next week. Need: X thread (3 tweets), LinkedIn single image + carousel, 15s teaser, and inbound routing spec. Can we lock owners and post times?

Ben Ortiz: I can do copy. Proposed times: X -> Thu 9:30am PT, LI -> Thu 12:00pm PT (different CTAs). UTM pattern: utm_campaign=serving_patterns_launch&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic.

Hannah Cho: Assets: I'll make 15s teaser + 3-card carousel. Using square + landscape exports. Need final hero line and speaker one-liners.

Omar Farouk: Ill handle HubSpot mapping. Plan: Form -> list 'SP_Launch'; registrant -> nurture sequence; attended -> assign to SDR w/ tag 'webinar_attended'. Also add variant tags: variant=a / variant=b for AB.

Ben Ortiz: Draft X thread (compact):
Tweet1: "Patterns > hacks: how teams serve LLMs reliably. Join our engineers.
Tweet2A (tech): "Well show caching + batching patterns that cut latency.
Tweet2B (outcome): "See how teams cut unit cost by ~40% with smarter serving.
Tweet3: "Register: short.link?utm_campaign=serving_patterns_launch"

Hannah Cho: Uploaded teaser + mockups to Drive (link here). Exported MP4 1080x1080 and 1200x675.

Leah Morgan: CTA mapping: X -> "Register" (captured by HS form). LI -> "Watch live" (drive-to landing with watch link). We'll label links with utm_content=variantA/B for tracking.

Ben Ortiz: Small copy tweak: add speaker Twitter handles inline for the X thread. Pasted final copy doc.

calendar-bot: Draft scheduled for review: X post Thu 2028-05-09 09:30 PT. Reviewer: @Leah Morgan.

Omar Farouk: HS workflow checklist I'll implement: 1) New form -> add to 'SP_Launch' list. 2) Send confirmation + calendar invite. 3) If attended -> mark 'Webinar - Attended' + create SDR task. 4) Tag source and variant. Sharing export after I build.

Hannah Cho: One design note: add speaker 1-line on first carousel card and logo on last card. Will add burned captions for teaser.

Leah Morgan: Owners: Copy & AB variants: Ben. Assets + export: Hannah. Scheduling + calendar: Leah. HS + routing: Omar. React with :thumbsup: if youre good.

Ben Ortiz: :thumbsup:

Hannah Cho: :thumbsup:

Omar Farouk: :thumbsup:

Leah Morgan: Thanks team 1 I'll post final links to #marketing-ops and confirm schedule in the calendar."
